simple.summary: אַמְרָפֶל (ʼAmrâphel) means Amraphel , a king of Shinar First listed occurrence: Gen 14 1.

definitions.full: H569. Amraphel אַמְרָפֶל proper name, masculine king of Shinar Gen 14:1 , 9 (probably = חמרבי , –ammurabi of Babylon, who reigned approximately , compare Schr SBA 1887, xxxi (June 23) COT ii. 296 f. Dl in De Gen 1887, Excursus ).
